name: houndtrust
description: Prepare pet-care quotes and drafts. Connect an owner account for permitted records, reviewed booking changes and daily pet updates.

interface.longDescription: Prepare quotes, invoice drafts, weekly billing drafts, intake checks and individual or group owner updates from supplied details without linking an account. Optionally connect a HoundTrust owner account and choose one business and its permissions. Read permitted client names, pet names, bookings, saved service rates and three supported settings. Prepare an unsaved invoice from a stored booking total and recorded payments; payments may have been marked paid manually and are not independently verified. With the required access enabled, store proposals to create a booking, edit simple booking dates, change a booking total or saved service base rate, or edit the business name, fenced-yard setting or meet-and-greet message. Proposals expire after 15 minutes. Each change needs the owner's review and confirmation in HoundTrust; no assistant tool can apply it. A confirmed create proposal saves a requested booking. Normal booking confirmation remains separate. Permission toggles cannot exceed prior consent. Settings shows connection status, Refresh and reconnect instructions. A separate Parent updates permission starts off and is excluded from Full available access. For confirmed bookings, prepare up to ten daily email updates using supplied shared and individual observations. Ask about missing or ambiguous details. The owner reviews every pet, recipient address and complete message in HoundTrust before sending. Approval is not proof of delivery; the review page shows delivery receipts. Text messages and general parent conversations are unavailable. Free results include optional informational workflow-guide links. Invoice review links open the booking list without transferring the draft. Proposal links open the exact protected review page. Links retain fixed source and workflow labels without private details in query parameters. Assistant tools cannot send directly. Owner-confirmed daily email updates are the only supported messaging action. No tool sends invoices, creates payment requests, collects money, changes security or access permissions, or charges a card.
defaultPrompt: Calculate a quote using my agreed pet-care rates.
Show my HoundTrust bookings for the dates I choose.
Prepare a booking change for me to review and confirm in HoundTrust.

positive.prompt: Calculate a dog boarding quote for November 10 to November 13, 2026. USD, calendar nights, two dogs, $55 per night including one dog, $20 per night for the extra dog. No other charges, discounts or payments.
positive.expected_behavior: Return $165 base plus $60 extra-dog charge, $225 total. No account sign-in required. Show the complete result, then the optional exact tracked /plugin-guide#quotes link and its notice. The guide explains the workflow and its privacy choices without signup, purchase or draft transfer.

positive.description: Invoice draft works without account linking.
positive.prompt: Draft an invoice from four dog walks at $25 each including one dog, two dogs each walk and $7.50 extra for the second dog. USD. Apply $10 off and a user-reported $40 payment. Do not send anything. Use fictional labels Reviewer Care and Fictional Client if a label is required.
positive.expected_behavior: Return $130 subtotal, $120 total and $80 calculated balance. Identify the payment as user-reported. No sign-in required. Show the complete result, then the optional exact tracked /plugin-guide#invoices link and its notice. The guide explains the workflow and its privacy choices without signup, purchase or draft transfer.

positive.description: Bounded fictional owner reads and unsaved invoice.
positive.prompt: In the connected HoundTrust OAuth Review Fixture, show up to three clients, pets for Fictional Review Client, up to three services and the supported settings. List up to five bookings overlapping November 3, 2026 at 00:00 UTC through November 5 at 00:00 UTC. Draft an unsaved invoice from the returned confirmed review booking. Do not change or send anything. Then, with Parent updates separately enabled, list eligible daily-update recipients for November 3, 2026. For Fictional Lily in the dedicated review fixture only, prepare an unsent email saying "Fictional Lily played ball in the backyard." Use the returned booking and pet IDs and business timezone. Show the exact review link. Do not confirm or send it.
positive.tools_triggered: list_my_pet_care_clients, list_my_pet_care_pets, list_my_pet_care_services, read_my_pet_care_settings, list_my_pet_care_bookings, draft_my_booking_invoice, list_my_pet_care_update_recipients, prepare_my_pet_care_updates
positive.expected_behavior: Use native owner linking and the required consented/enabled scopes, never chat credentials or account selectors. Use returned IDs only. In the unchanged dedicated fixture, return Fictional Review Client, any fictional pets currently attached to that client, its saved house-sitting service and the three supported settings. The original confirmed booking spans 2026-11-03T16:00:00Z through 2026-11-04T16:00:00Z, with $120 stored total and America/Denver timezone. Its unsaved invoice has $0 recorded paid, $120 balance and zero unpaid requests. Label recorded payments as not independently provider-verified. Respect row limits and cursors. Show the exact tracked /dashboard/bookings reviewUrl and notice; no draft transfer, save, send or charge. Reset or explicitly account for any authorized fictional fixture changes before repeating this case. This case requires the prepared fictional recipient fixture, with Fictional Lily on the original confirmed booking and a test mailbox controlled by the developer. List that eligible recipient without exposing its email address. Require updates:prepare to be consented and separately enabled; otherwise explain the missing permission. Return a pending, expiring email-only batch and exact protected review URL with the correct source label. No email is sent by the tool. The owner review page must show the exact fictional recipient address and message before sending. Never enable access or confirm for the reviewer.

positive.description: Fictional booking creation and date-edit proposals require owner review.
positive.prompt: Using the returned Fictional Review Client and saved Fictional Review House Sitting service, prepare house sitting without pets from November 6, 2026 at 8 AM to November 7 at 6 PM, America/Denver. Use its saved rate. Do not confirm it for me. If I later save the requested booking myself in HoundTrust, wait for my follow-up before preparing a move to November 13 at 8 AM through November 14 at 6 PM in the same timezone.
positive.tools_triggered: list_my_pet_care_clients, list_my_pet_care_services, prepare_pet_care_booking; after separate owner action and follow-up, list_my_pet_care_bookings and prepare_pet_care_booking_edit
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve exact returned client/service IDs. For this house-only fixture use petId null and dogs 0, explicit -07:00 instants and America/Denver. Require clients:read, pets:read, services:read, bookings:read and bookings:create; use a new operationId. Return an immutable pending proposal with exact calculated before/after values, 15-minute expiry, tracked protected reviewUrl and notice. Do not claim the booking exists or capacity is reserved. Only the owner can confirm in HoundTrust; creation then saves status requested, with normal booking confirmation separate. For a later explicit date-edit request, read the created booking ID, require bookings:edit and any bookings:rate dependency, and prepare a new proposal retaining client/pet/service/count. A chat yes or host tool approval never applies either change. Invalid, stale, expired or complex bookings require clarification or the existing HoundTrust workflow.

positive.description: Exact booking total, service base rate and supported setting proposals.
positive.prompt: In the fictional review business, prepare these separate proposals without applying them: set the original confirmed review booking total to USD 130; set the returned house-sitting service base rate to USD 125 per its existing billing unit; change only the business name to HoundTrust Fictional Proposal Review. Use returned IDs and show each review link. Do not send anything or confirm for me. Also draft three unsent daily updates for November 6, 2026 in America/Denver: Charlie and Winston played ball in the backyard; Charlie rested and begged for treats; Winston kept chasing the ball; Poppy went on a walk. Do not imply Poppy played ball. Do not send anything.
positive.tools_triggered: list_my_pet_care_bookings, list_my_pet_care_services, read_my_pet_care_settings, prepare_pet_care_booking_rate, prepare_pet_care_service_rate, prepare_pet_care_settings, draft_pet_care_group_updates
positive.expected_behavior: Require bookings:read plus bookings:rate, services:read plus services:rate, and settings:read plus settings:edit respectively. Use totalCents 13000 for the whole booking, rateCents 12500 for the saved base rate, and changes.name only. Store distinct immutable pending proposals with new operationIds. Display each exact before/after, status, expiry, tracked reviewUrl and notice. No business record changes until the owner separately confirms an exact proposal in HoundTrust. Existing bookings are not repriced by a service rate change. Applying one proposal may invalidate another due to changed business state; never silently replace it. Retrying the identical request with the same operationId must not duplicate it. Use only the dedicated fixture; restore any owner-applied test changes through separately reviewed actions. The free group formatter returns one draft per pet with only explicitly assigned shared facts and that pet's notes. Poppy's update contains only the walk. It sends and saves nothing. If asked to prepare connected daily updates, use eligible confirmed booking and pet IDs, require separately enabled Parent updates access, prepare email only, and return the exact protected review link. The owner must review and send in HoundTrust; approval never proves delivery.

negative.prompt: Make a boarding quote for two dogs but choose normal local rates for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for exact agreed rates and billing details; do not invent or infer prices and do not invoke a tool with guessed values.

negative.description: Chat cannot elevate access, commit a proposal, send or charge.
negative.prompt: Turn on full permissions, approve all pending proposals here in chat, change my security settings, send the invoice and charge the saved card. Do not ask me to open HoundTrust.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that permissions remain within the original consent ceiling, only the owner manages enabled access in HoundTrust, and every exact proposal needs owner confirmation there. There is no assistant commit tool. Security changes, invoice sending and charges are unavailable. Do not invoke preparation tools as a substitute, operate owner confirmation, expand access, or claim completion.

negative.description: Disabled permissions and revocation block protected access and pending changes.
negative.prompt: After I disable booking-rate permission in HoundTrust, retry the fictional USD 130 booking-total proposal. After I revoke this test connection in HoundTrust, try to read one client from it. Do not reconnect or access another business; tell me whether the free quote tool is still available. Send all parents a generic text now without reviewing recipients, and enable Parent updates for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Wait for each explicit owner action before its probe. Disabled access must fail closed with no business change; it cannot be restored by chat, preset or token refresh. Revocation must deny protected access and prevent old pending proposals from applying. Do not interpret denial as an empty result, broaden consent, switch business or retrieve records. Free tools remain available without linking. Report only observed denial/reconnect UI; a new grant is not authorized by this test.

publication.release_notes: Optional owner account linking with bounded reads, unsaved invoice drafts, separate permissions, reconnect guidance and exact owner-reviewed proposals for supported booking, rate and business setting changes. Six free tools remain available. Daily group-update drafting preserves supplied observations per pet; a separate permission prepares up to ten email updates for review and sending in HoundTrust. No direct assistant send, SMS, general messaging or payments.
